claim: In a What's New post dated Feb 5, 2025, AWS Step Functions increased the default quota for registered state machines and activities from 10,000 to 100,000; the new quota is automatically applied to all AWS accounts.

evidence.quote: AWS Step Functions has increased the default quota for the maximum number of registered state machines and activities from 10,000 to 100,000.
This new quota is automatically applied to all AWS accounts and requires no action on your part.

evidence.heading: AWS Step Functions now supports 100,000 state machines and activities per AWS account
